SYNTHETIC COMMERCIAL LEASE
Dated 15 February 2026 between Harbor Properties LLC (Landlord) and Juniper Studio Ltd (Tenant).

1. Premises
The Landlord leases Suite 402, containing approximately 1,200 square feet at 18 Market Street, Portland, Oregon, solely for a design studio.

2. Term
The lease term is two years, beginning 1 April 2026 and ending 31 March 2028, unless terminated earlier under this Lease.

3. Rent
The Tenant shall pay monthly base rent of USD 2,400 in advance on the first day of each calendar month. Rent increases by three percent on each anniversary of the commencement date.

4. Security Deposit
On signing, the Tenant shall pay a refundable security deposit of USD 4,800. The Landlord may apply it to unpaid rent or repair costs beyond ordinary wear.

\f
5. Utilities and Maintenance
The Tenant pays electricity and internet. The Landlord maintains structural components and shared areas; the Tenant keeps the Premises clean and promptly reports damage.

6. Alterations and Assignment
The Tenant must obtain the Landlord's written consent before making structural alterations or assigning this Lease. Consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.

7. Termination
Either party may terminate for a material breach if the breach remains uncured for thirty days after written notice. The Tenant may not terminate early for convenience.

8. Governing Law
Oregon law governs this Lease. State courts located in Multnomah County have exclusive jurisdiction.
